title: Reading Beyond OCR Noise: Robust Cross-Lingual RAG for Legislative Archives
abstract: arXiv:2610.35240v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: India's historical public archives present severe computer vision and document image analysis challenges: decades of parliamentary records survive only as degraded, multi-column scanned pages featuring mixed scripts, complex layouts, and dense visual noise where OCR failure is the primary obstacle to information retrieval. We present an end-to-end framework that couples vision-based layout segmentation and multi-script OCR with an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. Our approach specifically addresses how visual degradation and layout fragmentation propagate into text extraction errors, using an iterative agentic loop to navigate around OCR noise and layout ambiguities before generating answers. Evaluated on the 200,000-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha archive, our system demonstrates robust handling of historical document degradation, outperforming standard text-only baselines.

translated_title: 超越OCR噪声的阅读：面向立法档案的鲁棒跨语言检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 印度的历史公共档案带来了严峻的计算机视觉与文档图像分析挑战：数十年的议会记录仅以退化的多栏扫描页面形式保存，其特点是混合文字、复杂版面和密集的视觉噪声，其中OCR失败是信息检索的首要障碍。我们提出了一个端到端框架，将基于视觉的版面分割和多文字OCR与代理式检索增强生成（RAG）管道相结合。我们的方法专门研究视觉退化和版面碎片化如何传播为文本提取错误，并利用迭代式代理循环在生成答案之前绕过OCR噪声和版面歧义。在20万页的旁遮普邦立法议会（Punjab Vidhan Sabha）档案上的评估表明，我们的系统能够鲁棒地处理历史文档退化问题，性能优于标准的纯文本基线方法。
tldr: 本文提出一个将视觉版面分割、多文字OCR与代理式RAG相结合的端到端框架，通过迭代代理循环绕过OCR噪声与版面歧义，在20万页的印度旁遮普邦立法议会历史档案上实现了优于纯文本基线的鲁棒跨语言信息检索。
